claim_boundary: A fixed-method new-seed 600-second plus full-drain FIFO trajectory transition on 120 Poisson tapes. Caps and the uniform case/lane/aggregate compute rule were selected after the earlier development tapes. This run tests those choices on disjoint arrival seeds; it does not establish a stability theorem, capacity closure, physical multi-GPU performance, or a paper claim.

protocol.claim_boundary: A fixed-method new-seed 600-second plus full-drain FIFO trajectory transition on 120 Poisson tapes. Caps and the uniform case/lane/aggregate compute rule were selected after the earlier development tapes. This run tests those choices on disjoint arrival seeds; it does not establish a stability theorem, capacity closure, physical multi-GPU performance, or a paper claim.

compute_gate.aggregate: candidate < same-state K4096 shadow in every gate field
compute_gate.case: candidate <= same-state K4096 shadow in every gate field, uniformly for all six cases without exceptions
compute_gate.lane: candidate < same-state K4096 shadow in every gate field

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

trajectory_contract.candidate_method: one cold native canonical count-space B&B call; no trace, trigger, single-exchange, bulk polish, or rescue
trajectory_contract.candidate_state_shadow: one independent cold K4096 call on every candidate pre-dispatch state; audit only and never read by the candidate
trajectory_contract.common_tape_rule: one immutable tape per R/load/seed replayed by both executed arms
trajectory_contract.dispatch: global synchronous complete-job frames with FIFO within class
trajectory_contract.online_information: selectors receive only the released current queue, model, lanes and fixed budget
trajectory_contract.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at 600 seconds and fully drain both arms
